meta.title: VidSlice indexing pipeline
meta.subtitle: From raw materials directory to signed LanceDB index · 从原始素材目录到签名化的 LanceDB 索引

views.label: Ingest & extract
views.note: Operator launches the CLI, the scanner enumerates raw materials, and the extractor pulls keyframes with Pillow.

views.label: Embed, sign & deliver
views.note: Embedder vectors + enriches; writer signs LanceDB; ships back to operator or OpenCut pipeline.

messages.label: vidslice build ./materials --out index.lance · 启动 CLI
file list + sha256 manifest · 返回文件清单与哈希
video + image paths ready · 待抽帧路径就绪
N keyframes + codec/duration/px · N 帧关键帧与元数据
vectors + tags + provenance · 向量 + 标签 + 来源
signed index.lance + Ed25519 sig · 已签名索引 + 签名
publish to OpenCut pipeline · 推送 OpenCut 流水线

cards.title: Ingest
items: Operator points CLI at a materials directory · 操作员指定素材目录
Scanner walks files, hashes them, deduplicates · 扫描器遍历、去重并记录哈希

cards.title: Analyze
items: Extractor pulls keyframes with Pillow · 抽帧器用 Pillow 提取关键帧
Embedder computes vectors (NumPy) and attaches tags / provenance · 向量化用 NumPy 计算向量并附带标签与来源

cards.title: Act
items: Writer produces a LanceDB index signed with Ed25519 · 输出器写入 LanceDB 并用 Ed25519 签名
Operator delivers the signed index to OpenCut (or its HTTP pipeline) · 操作员把签名索引交付给 OpenCut
